summary:
Airtable is the spreadsheet-database tool at airtable.com. The triangular mark in the tab is what base bookmarks use, with the size read from the file.

Checked 12 November 2026 against airtable.com. HTML came from https://www.airtable.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://www.airtable.com/favicon.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://airtable.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 2467 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #ffbb00 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-48x48-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-48x48-01.png at 48×48 (png, 1505 bytes) from https://www.airtable.com/favicon.ico.
